evals.name: crm-contacts-list
evals.prompt: Build a CRM contacts list page that looks like Quiet Desk — warm calm UI, not purple SaaS. Include search, status filters, a dense table, and a primary New Contact button.
evals.expected_output: List page mode + compact density; semantic tokens only; espresso primary button; status pills mapped to good/warning/amber/muted; table with soft row hover; no marketing hero.
assertions: Uses List (or App shell + List) page mode, not Landing hero as main chrome
Primary action uses espresso solid styling language
No raw palette hex in component styles
Status colors limited to semantic tokens (good/warning/amber/muted/sage)
Density is compact or explicitly justified

evals.name: saas-marketing-landing
evals.prompt: Create a marketing landing page for a notes app using the Quiet Desk visual style: serif titles, soft cards, one CTA.
evals.expected_output: Landing mode + comfortable density; hero with one primary CTA; feature cards; warm neutrals; amber accents on icons.
assertions: Landing page mode with single dominant hero CTA
Card radius in 20–24px range or equivalent soft cards
Display serif or dual type roles respected
No neon gradient or emoji icons

evals.name: settings-form
evals.prompt: Design account settings (profile + notifications) in Coffee Minimal / Quiet Surface style.
evals.expected_output: Form/settings mode; grouped fields; primary Save + ghost Cancel; quiet labels; tokenized inputs.
assertions: Grouped sections with clear save action hierarchy
Destructive actions are not the default primary
